title: Add Money Without Real Money
audience: New learners and beginners practicing budgeting in test mode
objectives: Learn how to top up your PayProxy balance with sample funds for practice
Understand test-mode behavior and why no real money leaves your bank
Locate and confirm balance updates on the dashboard after adding money

analogy.title: Arcade Tokens for Your Wallet
analogy.text: Think of PayProxy like an arcade where you exchange cash for tokens before you can play. In this app, the Add Money button is the token counter — you’re not wiring money from your bank, you’re just loading practice tokens into your PayProxy balance to learn the game. You choose an amount, tap add, and those tokens instantly appear in your tray. You can then budget, spend, and track them on the dashboard just like a real wallet, but it’s all make-believe cash for learning.

pitch30Seconds: With Add Money, you can top up your PayProxy balance using sample funds to practice budgeting without any risk. Nothing leaves your real bank account — it’s all test mode. Just pick an amount and add it, then watch your dashboard balance update instantly. From there, you can plan spending, track budgets, and learn how money moves through the app. It’s a safe, hands-on way to build confidence before using real money with a future provider.
keyPoints: All added funds go directly to your PayProxy balance inside the app, not your real bank
Use a sample top-up to practice — choose an amount and add it with one tap
Your dashboard balance updates instantly so you can track and budget right away
No real money moves at all until a real payment provider is connected in the future

recallQuiz.question: What does the Add Money button do?
options: Transfers real money from your bank account to PayProxy
Adds sample money to your PayProxy balance for practice
Sends money to another user’s account
recallQuiz.explanation: Add Money adds simulated practice funds to your PayProxy balance so you can learn budgeting without using real money.

recallQuiz.question: What does test mode mean in this module?
options: Money moves slowly and takes days to arrive
No real money leaves your bank; all funds are simulated for learning
Your account is locked for testing and cannot be used
Only amounts under $1 can be added
recallQuiz.explanation: Test mode means everything is simulated — you are using sample money to practice, so nothing leaves your real bank.

recallQuiz.question: Where do you see your new balance after adding money?
options: On the PayProxy dashboard balance display
recallQuiz.explanation: Your PayProxy dashboard updates instantly to show the new balance after each sample top-up.

testModeNote: No real money ever leaves your bank when you use Add Money — all top-ups are simulated sample funds for practice only.
